summary_en: This study tests RPT1G, a selective hyperbolic NAMPT inhibitor, in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and high-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS). RPT1G is taken by mouth, and how long or how often it is given is not stated. The main goals are to learn whether RPT1G is safe and tolerable and to find the best dose and schedule; this is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa RPT1G, un inhibidor selectivo hiperbólico de NAMPT, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivante o refractaria y síndromes mielodisplásicos (SMD) de alto riesgo. RPT1G se administra por vía oral; la duración y la frecuencia del tratamiento no se indican. Los objetivos principales son saber si RPT1G es seguro y tolerable y determinar la mejor dosis y esquema; es un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: AML or high-risk MDS that has relapsed or is refractory, after standard therapy or declined standard therapy
Adequate liver function based on lab limits
not_for: No evidence of blood or bone marrow involvement
Symptomatic central nervous system involvement by AML
